meta.title: DAON — Korean Restaurant in Katowice
meta.description: DAON is a Korean restaurant in Katowice, Dworcowa 8: handmade ramen, Korean BBQ, hot pots and kimbap. See the menu and book a table.
meta.menuDescription: The full menu of DAON, a Korean restaurant in Katowice: Korean table sets, handmade ramen, kimbap, Korean BBQ, hot pots and more, with prices in PLN.
meta.reservationTitle: Book a Table — DAON Korean Restaurant, Katowice
meta.reservationDescription: Book a table at DAON, Dworcowa 8, Katowice: pick a day, a time and your table on the floor plan.
meta.privacyTitle: Privacy policy — DAON Korean Restaurant, Katowice
meta.privacyDescription: What data DAON collects when you book a table, why, how long it is kept and what your rights are under the GDPR.

languageHint.text: This page is also in English.

hero.lead: Charcoal, broth and fermentation — the three things a Korean kitchen is built on. We cook the way a family cooks at home, and we set the table the same way: everything at once, shared, still steaming.

about.title: A meal made with care
about.body: Daon is a Korean restaurant that blends authentic flavors with a modern touch, bringing the taste and culture of Korea to your table. Using fresh ingredients and heartfelt cooking, we offer a memorable dining experience for both locals and visitors.
about.note: Every dish on this site is taken from our printed menu — same names, same prices.
about.quote: We prepare every dish using only the finest quality and the freshest ingredients, carefully selected to ensure the best taste and authentic experience.

signature.title: What people order
signature.subtitle: A few plates that leave the kitchen most often.

categories.title: Thirteen chapters
categories.subtitle: From summer noodles to hot pots for four.

cta.title: Reserve a table
cta.body: Pick a date, a time and the table you want to sit at. It takes under a minute.

menu.title: Our menu

reservation.title: Book a table
reservation.subtitle: Date, time, guests, table. Four steps, nothing more.

date.title: When would you like to come?

time.title: Pick a time
time.subtitle: Tables are held for 15 minutes after the booked time.
time.none: No times left on this date.

guests.title: How many of you?
guests.large: We can seat up to {count} guests online, with tables pushed together. For a larger party call us at {phone} and we will lay out the room for you.

table.title: Choose your table
table.subtitle: Grey tables are already taken for this time. Pick where you would like to sit — for more than four we push tables together.
table.none: No table seats {guests} guests at this time. Try another time.
table.noJoin: no free table next to it for {guests} guests

details.title: Who is the table for?
details.name: Name
details.notesPlaceholder: Allergies, a birthday, a high chair… (optional)
details.privacy: Your data is controlled by {controller}, which uses your name, phone number and notes only to handle the reservation and deletes them {days} days after your visit. By writing allergy information in the notes, you agree to its use in preparing your visit.
details.emailHint: We send a confirmation with a calendar file and a reminder the day before your visit.
details.privacyEmail: Your data is controlled by {controller}, which uses what you enter here only to handle the reservation. Your name, phone number and notes are deleted {days} days after your visit, and your email address the day after it. By writing allergy information in the notes, you agree to its use in preparing your visit.

success.title: Your table has been reserved
success.body: The restaurant has your booking — there is nothing to confirm. If anything changes, call us on {phone}.
success.cancelled: Cancelled. The table is free again.
success.cancelFailed: We could not cancel it. Call us on {phone}.
success.emailSent: We have sent a confirmation to {email}.

changing.title: Check the change
changing.doneBody: The new time is saved and the restaurant already knows. If anything else changes, call us on {phone}.
changing.gone: This reservation can no longer be changed: it may have been cancelled, or its date has passed. Call us on {phone}.

errors.nameRequired: Please tell us a name for the booking.
errors.phoneRequired: We need a phone number in case anything changes.
errors.phoneInvalid: That does not look like a phone number.
errors.generic: The reservation could not be saved. Please try again.
errors.unavailable: That table was just taken. Please pick another one.
errors.offline: We could not check availability just now. Reload the page, or call us on {phone}.
errors.phoneLimit: This phone number already has the most upcoming reservations we can take online. Call us on {phone} and we will sort it out.
errors.rateLimit: Too many attempts from this connection. Please wait a little, or call us on {phone}.
errors.closed: We can no longer take bookings for that day or time — it may have just been closed. Please pick another date.
errors.incomplete: Something is missing from the reservation. Please check the highlighted step.
errors.timeLost: {time} is no longer free for {guests} guests. Please choose another time.
errors.emailInvalid: That does not look like an email address.

reservation.demoNotice: Demo booking — reservations are stored in this browser only and do not reach the restaurant yet. To book for real, call {phone}.

manage.missing: We could not find that reservation. It may have been cancelled, or its date has passed.
